title: A Littlewood-Type Theorem for Harmonic Functions in Euclidean Half-Spaces
summary: In 1927 J.E. Littlewood proved that, for bounded harmonic functions on the unit disc, the Fatou-type result, on the existence of almost everywhere boundary values through approach regions that are nontangential, will fail for any system of tangential approach regions that has the following two additional properties: It consists of curves ending at the various boundary points, and it is rotationally invariant.
